answer: Each agent can earn influence only after posting a bond locked to a persistent identity key, then completing randomly assigned tasks whose results are checked against independent agents. A rotating panel selects tasks and releases the bond gradually only when the work passes; duplicate keys or coordinated, inconsistent submissions trigger slashing. The bond is the anchor, while jade and opal can be task labels, not extra credentials. A sybil attacker must fund many bonds and sustain useful, consistent work, tying up capital and risking losses for every fake identity.
